Row1.Rationale: Afatinib is an irreversible pan-ErbB inhibitor that covalently binds EGFR, HER2 and ErbB4, leading to prolonged suppression of EGFR phosphorylation and downstream survival signaling in EGFR‑mutant NSCLC, translating into higher response rates and longer PFS versus chemotherapy and first‑generation TKIs in exon 19 del/L858R disease.
Row1.nl2sql_generated_sql:
SELECT gs.standard_name AS msigdb_name, 
       gs.collection_name AS collection, 
       gsd.description_brief AS description, 
       (CASE WHEN gs.standard_name LIKE '%EGFR%' OR gsd.description_full LIKE '%EGFR%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN gs.standard_name LIKE '%ErbB%' OR gsd.description_full LIKE '%ErbB%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN gsd.description_full LIKE '%mutation%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN gsd.description_full LIKE '%signaling%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN gsd.description_full LIKE '%survival%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sql_score
FROM gene_set gs
JOIN gene_set_details gsd ON gs.id = gsd.gene_set_id
WHERE (gs.standard_name LIKE '%EGFR%' OR gsd.description_full LIKE '%EGFR%' OR
       gs.standard_name LIKE '%ErbB%' OR gsd.description_full LIKE '%ErbB%' OR
       gsd.description_full LIKE '%mutation%' OR gsd.description_full LIKE '%signaling%' OR
       gsd.description_full LIKE '%survival%')
  AND (gs.collection_name = 'H' OR gs.collection_name LIKE 'C2:CP%' OR gs.collection_name LIKE 'C5:GO:BP%')
ORDER BY sql_score DESC
LIMIT 20
